findings.title: The full Space projection conflicts with the exterior allowlist
findings.claim: R-6 publishes the full Space partition, including per-ship AI controller rows, while the new allowlist says no other information about a rival ship is public.
findings.why: A plan writer cannot implement both the full-Space layout and the stated privacy test. Today's tactical serialization includes the hunter's mode, room and timing state.
findings.fix: Define a projected Space field list and redact per-ship AI state outside it. Apply the allowlist test to the decoded Space partition as well as ship blocks and other publication channels.

prior.note: R-2 now specifies a duel migration oracle and a versioned re-bless instead of requiring a byte-identical canonical array (spec L95-L98, L269).
Migration comparisons now exclude the version field and separately require old version plus one (spec L179; src/renderer/src/sim/canonicalFields.ts:L29; src/renderer/src/sim/duel/hash.ts:L11-L12).
The public exterior allowlist explicitly includes room damage, so the privacy assertion no longer rejects the specified summary (spec L223, L238-L239).
